items.headline: Tech Rally Drives S&P 500 and Nasdaq Higher; Dow Sees Modest Gain
items.summary: U.S. equity markets closed Thursday with the S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite posting solid gains, largely propelled by a surge in technology and software stocks following strong earnings reports from key AI-related companies. The Dow Jones Industrial Average also finished in positive territory, albeit with a more subdued performance. Overall market sentiment was buoyed by positive earnings, despite lingering inflation concerns and anticipation of tomorrow's Fed address.

items.headline: Salesforce Surges on Strong Q2 Earnings and AI Partnership
items.summary: Salesforce ($CRM) rallied over 20% after reporting adjusted EPS of $5.90, significantly above expectations, boosted by a $2.6 billion gain in AI startup Anthropic and an expanded partnership with the AI lab.

items.headline: CrowdStrike Jumps on Record Annual Recurring Revenue
items.summary: CrowdStrike ($CRWD) surged after reporting annual recurring revenue (ARR) of $5.84 billion in the second quarter, with net new ARR reaching a record-high of $333 million.

items.headline: Hormel Foods Dips Amidst Consumer Staples Weakness
items.summary: Hormel Foods ($HRL) experienced a significant decline, contributing to the consumer staples sector's underperformance today. Specific company news regarding the drop was not immediately available, but the sector faced selling pressure.

items.headline: Expedia Leads Declines in a Quiet Losing Session
items.summary: Expedia ($EXPE) led decliners, falling just under 5%. The broader losing side of the market was relatively subdued compared to the significant gains seen in tech.

items.headline: Information Technology Leads, Consumer Staples Lags
items.summary: The Information Technology sector was the top-performing sector today, gaining 3.40% driven by strong software and semiconductor performances. In contrast, Consumer Staples was the worst-performing sector, posting a loss of 1.50%.

items.headline: Fed Chairman Warsh to Address Inflation Concerns at Jackson Hole
items.summary: Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh is set to deliver a keenly awaited speech tomorrow at the annual Jackson Hole gathering, where investors hope for more clarity on his strategy to curb stubborn inflation. Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack reiterated her belief that a rate hike is needed, forecasting inflation to end the year around 3%.

items.headline: Nvidia and Salesforce Headline Strong Q2 Earnings Season
items.summary: The earnings season saw significant reports today, with Nvidia, Salesforce, and CrowdStrike all exceeding expectations, contributing to positive market sentiment, particularly in the technology sector. Best Buy also reported strong Q2 FY27 results, outperforming expectations.

items.headline: Census Bureau Releases Business Trends and Outlook Survey Data
items.summary: The U.S. Census Bureau today released new data products from the Business Trends and Outlook Survey (BTOS), providing continuous, timely data on business conditions and projections across various sectors and geographies.
